vulnerability.name: USN-8671-1
vulnerability.description: Adrian Junge was discovered that FFmpeg incorrectly handled certain media files. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a denial of service or execute arbitrary code. (CVE-2026-66036, CVE-2026-66039)  Adrian Junge discovered that FFmpeg incorrectly handled certain media files. An attacker could possibly use this issue to obtain sensitive information. (CVE-2026-66038)

statements.status_notes: Several security issues were fixed in FFmpeg. Available with Ubuntu Pro.
